status: Independent complete semantic reconstruction. Gate ordering and original unpublished row/elimination choices are not specified by the manuscript.

s.use: Only for optional private-anchor affine translation

expression_format.atoms: Integers are scalar constants; strings reference definitions or coordinates. Expressions are prefix JSON arrays.

kmul.more_than_two_arguments: Associative product, in the displayed order.

kpow.definition: Repeated product, nonnegative integer exponent; exponent0 gives field(1,0).

point_double.domain: b!=0; forced by the slope equation and curve equation

formal_product.definition: The second argument names a formal indeterminate; subsequent arguments are field-polynomial factors. It adds no quantified variable.

evaluate_field_polynomial.definition: Ordinary polynomial substitution at the displayed rational value. A field polynomial remains field-valued.

guards.justification: Required contact and pole exclusion. Inverse may be combined with other guards if the exact product is recorded.

guards.name: detector.0.trace
guards.justification: w0!=0 implies W!=0 and norm(W)!=0 over Q(sqrt(2)); Tr(W^-1)=2w0/norm(W).

guards.name: pole.0.B
guards.justification: R is nonzero and w0 inverse enforces nonzero trace; B=17*R/Tr(W^-1)^2.

guards.name: scalar.r
guards.justification: For rational X, beta=X^2+2 is >=2 and cannot equal2401 since2399 is not a rational square. Other roots are below2.

guards.name: scalar.b
guards.justification: Retained by Brox2483 and4165. W need not be globally nonzero merely by its rational formula; dropping this guard requires a separate arithmetic-only argument.

guards.name: scalar.preparation
guards.justification: If1+b*t^2=0 then b!=0 and the numerator is2b!=0. Thus U(1+b*t^2)=b(1-b*t^2) already forces the denominator nonzero.

forbidden_additional_guards: No nonzero guard on coordinate or scalar e,s,p,q,h, or scalar preparation t,U.
No nonzero guard on individual rational components of a halfpoint; this quartic uses all four halfpoint coordinates, not the one-ordinate chart.
No Lucas proxy coordinates or exact proxy Lucas equation.
No conic parametrization or finite conic selector in this quartic.
No normalized scalar R_beta, delta(beta), or enlarged 2^14 correction set; use original r_beta and 256 Boolean corrections.
No finite-algebra determinant witness or fixed elliptic exclusion product; use three-witness semilocal anchor.

optional_anchor_translation.warning: The published -3*A_num^2 form has A_num=4*anchor.A. Match actual compiled affine scaling before claiming coefficient-table identity.
